articleTitle: Using MBSE for Operational Analysis of Power Converter for Electric Traction
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Electric vehicles are a more environment friendly technology than internal combustion engine vehicles. However, EVs are still less mature technology compared to ICE vehicles (higher cost, lower power density, lower range rating, and longer charging time, connection to the grid⋯). In order to commercialize more EVs in the near future to make another step for replacing ICE vehicles, many researches have been conducted. The main three fields of interest are: electric motors, energy storage, and power electronics. EVs are considered as complex systems and need to be addressed with modern methodologies and approaches. This paper presents a first step towards designing a power converter for electric traction system with onboard energy storage system (ESS), using model-based systems engineering (MBSE) and systems modelling language (SysML), by adapting CESAM Systems Architecting Method as framework. Using this approach an operational point of view architecture of the power converter is presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Application of Synchronous Machines’ Models for Distance Learning Purposes
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents the creation of a set with appropriate web applications, using Matlab Web Apps. The set's aim is to ease the teaching process in distance learning for Engineering specialties in Electrical engineering. This set represents an adaptation of the existing test benches in the laboratory exercises of the discipline Electrical Machines part II, especially for the synchronous machines. The developed web applications propose a user-friendly and realistic user interface. The machines are modeled following the generalized theory of the electrical machines in the Matlab environment. The models are then transformed in web applications. The presented simulation and experimental results show good correspondence, which justify the applications' accuracy.

articleTitle: Magnetic Properties of FFF/FDM 3D Printed Magnetic Material
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Here is presented an estimation of magnetic properties of 3D printed by FFF/FDM technology soft-magnetic material. 3D printer filament material is printed by a new two-step technology proposed by authors. Different volumetric fill patterns are estimated according to its magnetic properties. Three fill patterns are compared, they are linear, hexahedral and triangular. Low density 3D printing patterns are reducing material consumption, energy usage and speed of manufacturing. However, measured results are showing drop of relative magnetic flux density curve with the lowering the density of the 3D printing pattern. Dependency of magnetic flux density and volumetric fill pattern is not linear and have a convex knee close to 40% fill factor. Results will be used for 3D printing methodology optimization for magnetic materials in electrical and electronic devices.

articleTitle: Design Variants Assessment Of Street LED Device Based On Virtual Prototyping
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This study is a demonstration of abilities of virtual prototyping to assess product variants at early stage of design development. It shows how a motivated descision could be found using evaluation of certain important performance parameters. The focus is set on an actual product design - a LED device which is sensitive to work environment. Its thermal management directly influences important parameters as reliability and overall performance. Presented virtual prototyping includes multiphysics or - thermoCFD analyses - and it is used as a basis for further design development.

articleTitle: Comparison of Failure Rates and Reliability of Power Semiconductors in Power Electronic Devices Using Methodologies MIL-HDBK-217F and FIDES
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Reliability prediction of power supplies, which are based on power transistors and diodes is a comprehensive process and depends on type of power elements, type of power circuit, control circuit, cooling system, operating and environmental conditions. The relatively accurate indicator for the reliability of given power supply is its operational reliability, based on reliability parameters of elements, blocks and systems which it consists. For calculation of reliability parameters of single electronic component can be used a various methodology such as: MIL-HDBK-217F, FIDES, RDF2000, 217F and others. That methodologies have a different type of models, correction pi-factors and covers a different operating, manufacturing, and environmental parameters. The choice of a method is based on knowledge of the methodology itself, the type of power semiconductors that have been used, their load and the environmental conditions. All mentioned methodologies provided different values for reliability parameters - failure rates and probability for failure free operation and for a reliability engineer it is a complex task to choose the right methodology. In this paper are compared reliability indicators of two types of power semiconductors (MOSFET transistor and power diode), analyzed by two of the widely used methodologies - MIL-HDBK-217F and FIDES.

articleTitle: Modelling of regenerative braking
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a discussion about simulation modelling of regenerative braking of electric vehicles. Electric vehicles are widely topical. Their drivetrain system can be effectively presented by an equivalent system consisting of a battery, a motor and a power converter. Regenerative braking enables part of energy used for braking to be transformed as electrical and recaptured by charging the battery. As this is one of the main advantages of these vehicles over petrol ones, this paper is purposed to explore the modelling and simulation of regenerative braking in MATLAB/Simulink environment. The model is considered for said equivalent system and consists of a Li-ion battery, a permanent magnet synchronous motor and a power converter. Results from simulation display a satisfactory torque and currents response as well as a raise in state-of-charge of the battery during regenerative periods with negative torque values. Following the simulation results a brief description of a stand for physical modelling of regenerative braking and studying in laboratory environment is given.

articleTitle: Advanced Machine Learning Approaches for State-of-Charge Prediction of Li-ion Batteries under Multisine Excitation
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The technological progress of e-Mobility has led to an increased use of Electric Vehicles (EVs), which today satisfies the majority of the customers' demands. Lithium-ion batteries are widely employed in EVs due to their attractive properties. However, the lithium cells, especially in urban traffic are subjected to intense dynamic loads, with a small share of static operation. The Battery Management System (BMS) has a key role in the EV's energy management system and in ensuring reliable operation. Since, a major task of a BMS is to determine the State-of-Charge (SOC) of the cell pack. Its accuracy depends on the model used in the BMS. Typically, simple empirical models are applied for this purpose. Furthermore, these models are parameterized by using standard test measurement data. The SOC prediction issue is still a concern of much research. In the field of energy storage systems, Machine Learning (ML) has recently emerged as a well-established modeling approach. This paper presents a comparative analysis of the performance of State-of-theArt Machine Learning approaches in SOC forecasting with regression, under dynamic loads. Data is generated by performing unique dynamic charge/discharge test by applying multisine signals. The results confirm that a great advantage of Advanced ML models is that they are able to capture important relationships between the variables of interest. Investigations has supported that the State-of-the-Art ML techniques outperform classical ML approaches and are powerful in SOC prediction problems due to their capability of storing past information and catching the cell dynamics, which is critical in predicting the future charge levels.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Control Design Based on the Genetic Algorithm for a Modular Servo System
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this article, an optimal Fuzzy PID controller is designed based on genetic optimization for a servo system. For the purpose of the study, an INTECO modular servo system is used in combination with Matlab/Simulink. The proposed controller is with a very simple structure. It uses a one-input fuzzy inference with three rules and six tuning parameters. Also, a conventional fuzzy logic controller with two inputs, 49 rules and three tuning parameters is used. As well a comparison is made with a Standard PID controller. The results of this study show that the system with the synthesized optimal Fuzzy PID controller based on genetic optimization has similar quality characteristics in comparison with the system with a conventional fuzzy PID controller and has a better performance in comparison with a standard PID controller. The use of the genetic algorithm for the synthesis of controller allows a significant reduction in the fuzzy rules base and simple tuning of the controller parameters.

articleTitle: Teaching Field Oriented Control using Animation
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Teaching the principles of control of electrical machines is a tedious job. Especially the required knowledge that has to be transmitted to the student is large, before a complete overview of the whole topic can be made. Also a solid background in both electrical machine dynamic behavior as well as in control theory is required for the student, before entering a course on Field Oriented Control [FOC] of electrical machines. However once the students have enough background information and if the new teaching material contains enough methods to practice the underlying theoretical contents, it is possible to teach students the basic concepts and practical implementation of FOC.

articleTitle: Induction Motor Simulink Implementation of the Rotor Flux Oriented Direct Vector Control Method for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This study aims to perform mathematical modeling of asynchronous motor and simulation of the rotor flux-oriented vector control method on a user-friendly platform. Besides, the obtained model is created as a PhiSim library, a product of Sherpa Engineering. This library was created using the bond-graph theory. Asynchronous motor is a good choice for electric vehicles due to its simple structure, low cost, high efficiency, robustness, high reliability, ability to work in bad environmental conditions, good dynamic performance, and wide speed range. The outputs from this study will serve the automotive industry. his simulation tool will be beneficial in investment decision-making processes and research.

articleTitle: A Realistic Virtual Lab for Investigation of Single-Phase Transformers
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this study is presented the development of a virtual transformer in the Engine for Virtual Electrical Engineering Equipment (EVEEE). Initially, the behavior of the transformer is modelled with an equivalent circuit, which is implemented with a SPICE circuit in the database of the engine. On graphical level the transformer is implemented with three PNG images. Next, a virtual lab is created that contains a transformer, an AC power source, a resistor decade and two multimeters. The functionality of the transformer is tested in three regimes: open circuit, short circuit and different loaded modes. The obtained results showed that the developed transformer is working correctly and the created lab could be used in the educational process for emergency situations such as the COVID-19 crisis.

articleTitle: Influence of Magnet Dimensions on Torque Components and Cost of Synchronous Machine with Interior Magnets
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents a study on interior permanent magnet (PM) synchronous machine (SM). The influence of PM dimensions on the electromagnetic torque and its components (torque from PM and reluctance torque) is investigated. The SM torque is calculated using an approach proposed by the authors based on FEM analysis and analytical formulae. The results show influence of the magnet width and magnet height on the torque of the machine. It is proven that the torque of the machine is affected much more by the width of the magnets than by their height. As a result from the study it is concluded that there are possibilities for significant reduction of the volume of magnets without sacrificing the machine torque. In the paper, it is also discussed the possible financial savings due to reduction of PM mass and price.

articleTitle: Investigation of Thermoelectric Cooler System Effect on Induction Motor Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Induction motors are generally cooled by the fan connected to the motor shaft, as the cooling of electrical machines is important. In this study, an alternative method is proposed for cooling of induction motors. Thermoelectric coolers are used in the proposed system and these coolers effects on the system are investigated. While the heat generated by the induction motor during its operation is removed from the motor with thermoelectric elements and aluminum fans, the temperature has been tried to be reduced by the thermoelectric elements acting effect as a thermoelectric cooler. The thermoelectric effect efficiency used in the system is determined by the Peltier effect. In this proposed method, the temperature formed on an induction motor with a power of 370 W is reduced by approximately 11% with the thermoelectric coolers. According to this value, the investigations in this study demonstrated that, in contrast to traditional methods, Thermoelectric cooler modules can be developed and used for cooling induction motors. Thus, a new cooling class could be created for induction motors whereby life cycle could be increased and operating costs reduced.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm for Generation of PV Panel Curves From Datasheets
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The current paper proposes an algorithm for datasheet parameter extraction for photovoltaic modules. The extracted parameters are relevant to single diode photovoltaic cell model and allow for synthesis of IV and PV curves. The extracted parameters are obtained by approximation trough a genetic algorithm. The paper presents the structure of the genetic algorithm and discusses suggested fitness function and methods selected in order to improve accuracy and execution time. The algorithm is verified where accuracy and key parameters are presented.

articleTitle: Challenges of Online Laboratory Electrical Engineering Exercises
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents some of difficulties that the professors of the Department of Theoretical Electrical Engineering have with the laboratory exercises teaching in online environment. During pandemic and spread of COVID -19 everyone's life has changed and nothing is as the same as before. This change also reflects on the way of teaching not only of the theoretical material - lectures and tutorials, but also the acquisition to the practical skills in distance teaching.

articleTitle: Data Acquisition Board for Monitoring and Analysis of Electrical and Non-electrical data on Board of a Vessel
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: With the development of shipping and the technologies used in it, it is necessary to introduce new techniques to improve communication between crew and operator, as well as reduce the amount of work performed on board. In this paper is purposed, a system for collecting a wide range of data that can be used for monitoring, analysis and diagnosis.

articleTitle: Implemented PLC System Controlling the Cleaning of Heat Exchangers in the Extraction of Heat Energy from Geothermal Water
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents the features and the characteristics of an implemented PLC system for control of the operation of the heat exchangers of a developed and implemented original heating system from a geothermal source of a large public building in the city of Varna, Bulgaria.

articleTitle: Regression Model of a Thermoelectric Generator based on Peltier Modules
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The present paper reports for the results obtained from studies on a thermoelectric generator (TEG) based on Peltier modules. To find the particular optimal conditions for thermoelectric generation, experiments were carried out using specially designed for the purpose thermoelectric battery (TEB). The results obtained were used to create theoretic-experimental model employing the method of regression analysis. The model was single-target optimized by two methods- genetic algorithm and method and random search method using the QStatLab software. The optimal combinations of values of the temperature difference, the load resistance, and the number of thermocouples included in the TEB to generate the highest thermal electromotive voltage were determined.

articleTitle: Investigating the Influence of an Electronic Device’ Properties on Its Temperature Regime
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this study is investigated the influence of different constructional and environmental parameters of a PCB with SMD components on its thermal regime. The dependent variables are the temperature of the PCB and the temperature of the device' box. The simulation was conducted for the following independent variables: the input power, the temperature of the environment, the height of the PCB coating and the cross-section of the mounting area between the PCB and the box. Furthermore, several scenarios with different parameters of the filling resin were investigated as well as the influence of the material of the box. The obtained results showed that the diameter of the mounting areas could have an impact on the PCB temperature, while the coating height is insignificant. Furthermore, using additional one-sided silicon filling provided a very significant drop in the PCB temperature. Similar results were obtained when using metal box.

articleTitle: Statistical Approach for Designing Generic 18650 Battery Model
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Most battery models are designed by estimating its parameters of one or two different cells. During simulations, these models perform satisfactorily and produce results very close to reality. The problem occurs when measurements are conducted with cells from different manufacturers and large variations are observed during the dynamic loads. The purpose of this paper is to design a general model for 18650 designed batteries, which provides as little deviation as possible when using different cell types. To establish the general model, constant load, transient, and dynamic load tests on 8 different cells are performed. An Ordered Weighted Averaging operator is used to standardize the measurement results and determine the model parameters. Outliers are filtered out using the weight parameter. To create the battery model a two-time-constant circuit model is used in MATLAB Simulink. Worldwide Harmonized Light Vehicle Test Procedure (WLTP) tests are used to validate the results.

articleTitle: Reactive power of nonlinear sign - changing loads
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a discussion about simulation modelling of reactive power and its control by a single- phase inverter in a photovoltaic system. Reactive power is one of the most important electrical magnitudes that requires proper control in a system. The simulation is done in MATLAB/ Simulink environment. The model consists of a single- phase photovoltaic inverter, a source representing the grid and control of said inverter. Currents and voltages are subjected to Clarke's and Park's transformations following p-q theory. As the model is operating with a single- phase inverter only the quadrature component is considered. This component is further passed to a proportional - resonant controller which is considered a suitable replacement to proportional - integral one as it can introduce infinite gain at fundamental frequency. Simulation results present satisfactory waveform of both voltage and current that are injected to the grid.

articleTitle: Application of ANN for forecasting of PV plant output power – Case study Oryahovo
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Nowadays, the prediction of energy production of grid connected photovoltaic (PV) power plant is important for ensuring the quality and continuity of power supply. In this context, this paper analyzes different approaches for prediction of PV power output, using Artificial Neural Network (ANN). The Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) ANN method is widespread in the scientific literature for foresting of the solar irradiance and PV power output. The ANN is modeled using five years of solar data, measured or estimated using previous research and the measured power output at each 10 minutes. The accuracy of the optimal configuration is around 8% for the RRMSE.

articleTitle: Educational Set-up for Brushless Motor Drives
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Traditionally the brushed DC motor is the first motor that students encounter in a laboratory assignments on electrical drives. However a number of simplifications are taken into account when explaining the workings of the brushed DC motor. Considering basic knowledge of electromagnetic principles, the attraction between a magnet and a current carrying winding is easily accepted by students. A Brushless DC motor drive, which is based on this electromagnetic principle, is an easy to understand motor drive when it comes to the control of the motor. All underlying physical properties of the brushless DC motor drive are easier to visualize compared to the brushed DC motor with mechanical commutator. Therefore this motor drive more is suited as an introductory course in motor drives. Virtual online experiments as well as lab assignments are demonstrated that visualize every aspect of the brushless motor drive. The basic models for simulation and animation are presented and a typical laboratory set-up is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Application of an Inductive Power Transfer System for Charging Modern Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper summarizes the performance parameters of modern electric vehicles to establish their average values. Based on this hypothetical electric vehicle, a review of the charging stations, including wireless ones, available on the market is performed. A wireless charging station is proposed based on an existing development, and investigated and consequently adapted to operate with an output power of 22 kW.

articleTitle: Identification of Moving Lightning Clouds Using Four-dimensional Electromagnetic Potential
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The case of identification of a moving lightning cloud is being considered. An application of the four-dimensional magnetic potential is given. Relativistic computational method and models are used for determination of the electromagnetic field. A four-dimensional magnetic potential in cases of arbitrary velocity of movement can be used. The cases of the electromagnetic field distribution in moving environments with arbitrary speeds are being investigated. The electromagnetic field vectors as elements of Maxwell's tensor are defined. The elements of four-dimensional magnetic potential are magnetic vector potential and scalar electric potential. Analytical expressions for the electromagnetic field vectors using the four-dimensional potentials have been obtained. The components of the electric field and magnetic field, created by motion from moving charge, presenting lightning cloud, have been found. By solution of inverse problem, the quality of charge, its coordinates and velocity have been determined.

articleTitle: Conceptual Model of a Remote Laboratory for Investigation of DC Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this study is presented a conceptual model of a remote lab for investigation of DC electrical machines. The model is explained on different levels. Initially, the architecture of the system is presented and its use cases are summarized. The study identifies the main actors that work with the virtual lab (the student and the teacher) and describes their roles. Next is explained the structure of the system, including its main modules, their functions and the interaction between them. On a different scale, the interaction between the user, the server and the remote equipment is presented using an activity diagram. The study continues with defining the main regimes of operation of the remote lab system and the quantities that should be either monitored with sensors, measured or approximated. The developed conceptual model will be the base for implementing a remote lab for investigation of DC electrical machines.

articleTitle: Investigation of Digital Protection Relay For Three-Phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article considers a simplified circuit solution for protection of induction motors through a device which provides reliable protection of a wide range of faults leading to unwanted interruptions of a variety of technological processes. The design of the electrical device is classical in combination with an electronic unit for monitoring the electrical parameters of the circuit. The operation of the protective device has been tested, and the results compared with similar devices.

articleTitle: Adaptive Controller for Induction Machine Direct Torque Control
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this article is proposed a direct torque control of induction motor with additional control signal from adaptive controller. It`s signal is summed with the those from the conventional PI regulator and the result is the reference torque signal. Using the created mathematical model, the modes of operation of an induction electric drive with adaptive control under various disturbing influences are investigated.

articleTitle: Modeling of Hybrid System with Photovoltaic Panels-Fuel cells Generation and Hydrogen Storage Using Electrolyzer
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper deals with modeling of stand-alone hybrid system, which uses photovoltaic installation and fuel cell stack for generation and electrolyzer with hydrogen tank for storage. The components of the system are modeled with appropriate mathematical equations, describing the specific phenomena for each element, and implemented in Matlab Simulink environment. Simulation results are presented for 9 days, using meteorological data from experimental set-up in Ajaccio, France. The results show a good functionality of the system and confirm the possibility to use it for satisfaction of stand-alone consumer.

articleTitle: Modeling Tool For Determination Of The Available Energy In Battery Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper is presented a Matlab/Simulink-based modelling tool for estimation of the State of Charge of Li-ion battery cells. The model is based on lookup tables, which makes it easy to implement in complex battery bank models, containing a large number of cells. The proposed model allows determining the state of the charge for any current based on interpolations. The developed model takes into account the variation of the battery usable capacity by discharging with different C-rates. The model is also applicable for cells with different capacities or different characteristics, according to experimental measurements or the producer datasheets. The model input variables are the discharge current of the cell and the initial State of charge and the outputs are the cell voltage and the cell State of charge. The developed model is validated by experimental results.

articleTitle: Some Opportunities to Improve the Learning Process of Students Based on Computer Simulations
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents some opportunities for improving the quality of distance learning process of students, based on computer simulations. The considered examples illustrate simulations of electromagnetic processes and phenomena that cannot be studied in a real laboratory environment due to the Covid 19 pandemic. The aim is to facilitate the understanding of the material and significantly increases the possibility for self-learning process using FEM simulations of the studied phenomena.

articleTitle: Methodology for effectiveness in applying for grant funding for energy efficiency of enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The report presents a detailed methodology for effectiveness in applying for grant funding for energy efficiency of enterprises. The general approach, which determines the potential efficiency, is indicated, on one hand, on the basis of the financial resources received from the operational programme, and on the other hand, the costs and the risk borne by the beneficiary implementing such type of grant funded projects.

articleTitle: Study a Converter for Voltage Equalization of Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this work, an electronic converter used for voltage equalization of connected in series supercapacitor cells is presented. It is studied the voltage variation of the auxiliary secondary winding, used for supplying the transistors drivers, connected in the main secondary winding. Its voltage changes depending on the current used for charging the supercapacitors and the voltage across them. The equations shown can be used for engineering design of the high frequency transformer.

articleTitle: Insights Into the Urban Electric Transport System by Means of Comparative Analysis of Different Power Theories
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This report examines two power theories- one in the time domain and the other in so called hybrid domain. Both power theories are applied in the analysis of an urban electrical transport and a comparative analysis between them is made.

articleTitle: Design, Building and Study of a Small-size Portable Thermoelectric Refrigerator for Vaccines
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: For cooling small volume compartments, the thermoelectric systems have a number of advantages over the classic compressor refrigerators. Their priority is due to the active components in their design - Peltier modules which are chemically inactive, have no moving parts and do not practically need maintenance [1-2]. The thermoelectric cooling systems have the potential to meet the requirements for storing and transportation of vaccines and other medical solutions at low temperatures posed by the global pandemic of Covid-19. The electrical systems in the vehicles are excellent prerequisite for compatibility with the thermoelectric refrigerators requiring stable power supply.The aim of the present work was to design, realize and study a prototype of a small scale mobile thermoelectric cooling system for negative temperatures based on Peltier modules.

articleTitle: Voltage Stabilization in Current Inverters with Fully Controllable Switches
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper describes a current inverter scheme, based on fully controllable switches with a low modulation frequency of the output curve. There are two ways to regulate the output voltage in the proposed system. The first way is changing of the input current pulses amplitude of the inverter, the second - changing of their duration. This allowed proposing of three methods for stabilization of the output voltage. The realization possibility of the parallel operation of three output-joined current inverters with automatic regulation of the output voltage and load distribution between inverter modules is considered. The obtained results analysis allows recommending of the studied inverter and considered stabilization methods in combined microgrid systems with a common AC bus.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Influence of Hysteresis on the Characteristics of Direct Torque Control of Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this article is made an investigation of the influence of hysteresis bandwidth over operational characteristics of induction motor performance and electrical power quality. Direct torque control method is used with adaptive regulator in the control loop.

articleTitle: Arc Faults in Low-Voltage Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Studying of arc faults is a complex problem the solution of which helps assure safe operation of low-voltage distribution networks. A series arc fault and devices intended to clear it are investigated. The arc volt-ampere characteristics obtained experimentally on a specially developed test bench under series arc fault conditions will be used for simulating this fault in the Matlab/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Single Phase PFC Topology Selection Based on Neuron Network Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The current paper presents a specialized algorithm for an expert system for converter topology selection. The algorithm is aimed at providing suggestions for an optimal topology for a single phase power factor correction converter, in terms of preferred levels of efficiency, cost and footprint size. The algorithm is developed using neuron networks and procedurally generated solution training data base build using data sets for existing semiconductor and magnetic devices. Results regarding verification and accuracy assessment of the algorithm are presented.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic field evaluation in building located close to high-voltage overhead line
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The magnetic and electric fields created of overhead line located in a densely populated area, near a residential building are investigated. The goal of this study is to model the fields created of 110 kV distribution line, located in highly urbanized environment and to evaluate the field impact on the residential building, situated very close after new construction. The electromagnetic compatibility of high-voltage line is considered. To find the electromagnetic field components, a method using numerical solution of Maxwell's equations by finite-element method FEM is used. The magnetic field model is based on Poisson's equation and on using of magnetic vector-potential. A modeling and simulation makes it possible to analyze real configuration and evaluate magnetic field levels and to establish electromagnetic compatibility. The electric and magnetic field levels in areas of the building are evaluate to verify the requirements of necessary exposure. The electromagnetic field has been investigated, taking into account the closer vicinity, where located a building recently built near the power line and it is possible to obtain high levels of the field. A magnetic flux density has relatively large values in a several areas of the building. The obtained electrical intensity levels are low, relative to the permissible norms for public exposure and ensure necessary safety requirements. The study allows the influence determination of the magnetic field and electric field of humans and can be evaluated risks of human health.

articleTitle: Case-study for HW Accelerated FEA Model for Electrical Machine Control Prototyping
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The challenging market in the e-mobility domain requires higher speed of development. To accelerate the time to market of the products, this phenomena is also addressing the tools and methods are used in the procedure of development. System simulations are widely used to control prototyping with validation purposes. Within a frame of a case study this paper presents the most common branches of the e-machine simulation methods. Highlights the main benefits and downsides of the simulation schemes. Draws results and sources from studies, are done in the field of finite element based e-machine modeling and simulation by the engineering community. These applications are evaluated and giving overview about the complexity of model structures, details and the computational sources from the perspective of required value of run-time. Explains the common approaches of the e-machine simulation methods, with an investigation in the field of hardware accelerated finite element analysis. Invests within the available studies and experiences from different non e-machine applications of the finite element method. Consequently notes a form of application and adaption of these techs of the finite element analysis that keep the tempo of development at a high-rate beside to offer a more detailed simulation than traditionally used tools for control prototyping purposes.

articleTitle: Analysis of short circuit currents in interface nodes of Kitka wind power park in Kosovo
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper the influence of DG on the level of short circuit currents in different connection nodes on and near the territory of a wind park (interface nodes) is analyzed. Four types of short circuit currents (three-phase short-circuit current, two-phase short circuit current, two-phase short-circuit current with ground and single-phase short circuit current) are analyzed in different locations of existing electrical network. For calculations and simulation of short circuit currents, DigSilent PowerFactory software package has been used, with which the turbine park has been modeled for the simulation and calculation of fault currents. The Kitka Wind Turbine Park operates in the Kamenica region of Kosovo. All simulations were performed with accurate data for wind generators, cables, transformers, and lines. The aim is to study the levels of fault currents with different combinations of wind generators in parallel operation. It is a part of a thorough analysis of the impact of the renewable electricity production entities on the electric power system (EPS) of Kosovo.

articleTitle: Optimization of Switching Performance of Power MOSFET with Active Driver with dv/dt Feedback
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Using an active driver with feedback on a derivative of drain voltage dv/dt to reduce high-order harmonic frequencies and reduce active losses in MOSFET control is researched and analyzed in this paper. Studies have been performed in the control of R-L load and supply voltage 12V. A comparison is made between the exponential change of the current through the load in controlling with a standard driver and change of current when driving with active driver. The article found that the active driver reduces the active power losses on the transistor. The studied active driver is suitable for control of DC-DC converters operating by the method of pulse-width modulation.

articleTitle: Automated LabVIEW measurement LLC System Control GUI
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents a system for automated acquisition based on the LabVIEW software. The main concept is to conduct experiments and acquire the results in database, which would allow further analysis and discovery of concepts and processes. The stand is based on a LLC resonant converter evaluation module, but the concept could be applied to other types of power electronic converters and test benches.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Global Solar Radiation and Solar Energy in Ruse, Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In the present study is performed a harmonic analysis of the global solar radiation for the region of Ruse, Bulgaria. The study is based on radiation data obtained from a meteorological station in the campus of the University of Ruse. Initially, basic statistical analysis was performed. Thereafter, the constant term and the first three harmonics were obtained for the average daily solar radiation in each month of the year. The obtained results showed that for the region of Ruse the average solar radiation could well be approximated with only its constant term and first component. The obtained results could be used as input data in PV and solar simulation software.

articleTitle: A “Single Component” Approach for Electronic Units’ Reliability Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a reliability prediction approach for electronic units during their operation, in order to optimize the maintenance process especially when reliability-centered maintenance is conducted. For this purpose, based on the reliability prediction methodology FIDES2009, the most appropriate parameters and equations are fetched out to be combined in a suitable approach for estimating the physical reliability of an electronic unit with various complexity, considering it as a single component.

articleTitle: Ferrofluid Brake Electromagnetic Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: We propose a numerical model of magnetic brake design with viscose ferrofluid as controllable friction material. Friction damping force is controlled by an electric coil, where the current value is regulated depending on the rotational speed of the device. Results about friction force and total braking force/torque are obtained by coupled finite element method modeling and electromagnetic brake kinematical model. Effects of the viscose ferrofluid over the breaking force and torque are estimated.

articleTitle: Study of Faults and Power Outages in Power Distribution Grids
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The reliable power supply of consumers with electricity indicators that meet the regulatory requirements is a major issue for electricity distribution companies. In this regard, the regulatory framework is well developed. Every year, the electricity distribution companies must meet the requirements set for them both in terms of electricity quality and continuity of power supply at medium voltage level - SAIDI and SAIFI.The purpose of the paper is to make an analysis of the different types of disconnections: automatic and manual, disconnections from relay protections, short-term and long-term power outages in distribution grids 20 kV. The consequences for the distribution companies and consumers regarding the duration and undelivered electricity due to long-term and short-term outages have been analyzed as well.

articleTitle: Study of the Parameters of an Autotransformer Discrete Alternating Voltage Regulators Considered as a Two-Port
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The study is devoted to the analysis of an autotransformer discrete alternating voltage regulator as a two-port. The hybrid matrices were determined by using a simulation model of the regulator in MATLAB. The examined regulator consists of four semiconductor commutators (thyristor switches), corresponding to the different levels of the input supply voltage. The received results were experimentally verified and a good correspondence smaller than 1,2% was admitted.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic System for LED Lighting Based on Bidirectional Cuk-converter - Computer Research
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article examines a system for conversion and storage of energy, consisting of photovoltaic panels, ultracapacitor and LED lighting. A bidirectional Cukconverter is used for a matching converter for energy transfer between the different components. The transfer of the energy can be from the photovoltaic panels to the ultracapacitor or from the ultracapacitor to the LED lighting. An photorelay is used to determine the direction of transmission. The advantage of the system is the use of only one converter. Here are presented schematic diagrams and results of research by computer simulation in the following cases: energy transfer from the photovoltaic panels to the ultracapacitor in Cukconverter step-down and step-up modes, energy transfer from the ultracapacitor to the LED lighting in Cuk-converter stepdown and step-up modes.

articleTitle: Active Learning for Teaching “Synthesis and Analysis of Counters” in the Course “Digital Electronics”
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Every machine around us has digital electronics. Even computer specialists use it every day. For this purpose, one of the basic courses in their curriculum is “Digital Electronics”. The paper presents active learning methods used for teaching the topic of “Synthesis and Analysis of Counters” and the solution of the students for the tasks.

articleTitle: Adapting Electrical Engineering Assessment for Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: For a quality education for students are important not only the teaching methods and technologies used, but also the methods used for assessing the knowledge of students. In this article we explore the use of multiple-choice test with closed-ended questions as an assessment method in online learning for subjects such as Electrical Engineering and Electronics - how and what questions to define to guarantee an objective assessment.

articleTitle: New Time Indices for the Operational Reliability Assessment Regarding Electronic Items
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The new approaches to assessing operational reliability by introducing a new time indices are discussed in this paper. The case study and experimental results are based on real data. A comparative analysis of the classical approach and the proposed approaches as well for assessing the operational reliability is also presented.

articleTitle: Renewable energy from two-stage anaerobic digestion of organic wastes
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Experimental studies of two-phase anaerobic digestion of corn steep liquor (a waste product from processing corn grain for starch extraction) were performed. For the first time, an automatic mode of operation was implemented in continuous processes with simultaneous production of hydrogen and methane using the developed computer system for monitoring and control of pilot bioreactors. The best results for daily biogas yield were obtained at an organic load of 20 g/L for hydrogen producing bioreactor, as the daily yield of biohydrogen is 0.74 dm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/L at a hydrogen concentration in biogas of 32.6% (0.24 dm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/L pure biohydrogen) and the daily biomethane yield in the methane producing bioreactor is 0.587 dm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/L at a methane concentration in biogas of 69% (0.4 dm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/L pure biomethane). The obtained energy is more than 40% compared to the traditional single-stage methane production process. A disadvantage is the need for additional purification from hydrogen sulfide of both gases before obtaining electricity and/or heat.

articleTitle: Project-Based Learning in the Topic of Harmonic Oscillators of Clapp
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Students from engineering specialties need to learn essential skills like critical, logical, and analytical thinking, problem-solving, working with special equipment, etc. One method can combine all of them and this is project-based learning. This paper presents project-based learning used during the semester in the course “Radio Communication Technologies” describing a type of problem presented by students and an example of their solution about an individual project on the topic of Harmonic Oscillators of Clapp.

articleTitle: Method for Body Pose Recognition based on Two-Finger Touch Bezel on Wearable Device
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Nowadays, wearable devices are becoming more and more widely used. The development of interfaces for wearable devices is a challenge due to their small size on the one hand and on the other hand - their increasing capabilities (respectively functions) that must be managed by their interface. The purpose of the presented study is to propose a method for recognizing the pose of the user (lying, sitting, standing) when waking a wearable device from sleep mode. The experimental study and results are given.

articleTitle: Open Source Electronic System for Controlling of Hybrid Electromagnetic Systems with Magnetic Flux Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The use of open-source software and hardware systems in engineering applications is constantly growing. In this paper, an open-source system for controlling hybrid electromagnetic system with magnetic modulation is developed and tested. Some results when powering the tested device with pulses of different frequency are shown.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Mathematical Simulation of the Stator Slot of a Turbogenerator, Including Thermal Modeling and Flow Fluid Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this article, the authors explain the principles of creating a three-dimensional symmetrical part of the stator slot of a turbo generator including thermal modeling and flow fluid dynamics. Various physics interfaces were used to create a complete numerical simulation model. To link variables in various physical interfaces, multiphysicists were used with their own differential equations. As a result of work in the COMSOL Multiphysics software, careful multiphysics mathematical models of the stator clot of the turbine generator were built. For the calculation in the program, the finite element method was used with the correct setting of the initial and boundary conditions. Building such complex models can not only improve the design process, but also enable analysis for various insulation systems. For example, air-cooled turbine generators initially use the Global VPI insulation system, but when replacing the stator winding, for economic reasons, a different insulation system is used - Resin Rich. For a correct transition to another insulation system, it is necessary to carry out complex calculations, including thermal ones. In practice, when changing the insulation system due to thermal constraints, it may be necessary to reduce the rated total power of the turbine generator for its further operation without overheating of the stator winding, which can be obtained on the basis of simulation. The equivalent coefficient of thermal conductivity, which can be preliminarily analyzed to select the necessary materials for thermal properties and their fill factor to maintain the nominal parameters of the turbine generator during rewinding, is very important for the calculation, as it allows you to optimize the model settings and the computation time.

articleTitle: Possibilities for Determining the Apparent Power Components When Ship Synchronous Generator is Operating
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The modern development of marine propulsion drives leads to more and more frequent requirements of the electric motor as the main propulsion element, and its control is carried out by frequent converters. The conversion of electrical energy AC-DC-AC leads to certain power losses and problems in the operation of generators. This paper presents a study of a synchronous generator in different operating states using the space vector theory and the instantaneous power theory to determine the processes of the co-operation of a synchronous generator and a load.

articleTitle: Comparison of Energy Management Strategies in a Microgrid with Photovoltaic/Battery System
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Using PV energy sources decreases the supply of electrical household energy by the main grid. Energy management strategies are here developed and applied to a microgrid connected to a PV plant coupled to a battery storage; this microgrid supplies in electricity a building and an electric car. The objective is to analyse the impact of the management strategy on the cost and on the energy part in considering the current electricity tariff in France. Some strategies require a forecasting tool of the PV power and it is shown that the energy strategy performance increases with the complexity of the decision algorithm and the use of PV forecasting.

articleTitle: Comparison of Inductor Machines With Different Types of Excitation
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This work is aimed to the comparison of inductor machines with three different types of excitations: permanent magnets, copper field winding, and high-temperature field winding. Here the results of electromagnetic calculations of considered magnetic system are presented analyzed. We study the distribution of magnetic field in magnetic system of machine and torque characteristics. The presented static characteristics make it possible to evaluate the possibility and efficiency of using the HTS winding as an excitation in an electric machine intended for a flywheel energy storage.

articleTitle: Power Quality Analyzers Calibration on Total Harmonics Distortion of Voltage and Current by Reference Square Waveform Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: For calibrating the Power Quality Analyzer by Total Harmonic Distortion of voltage and current, a calibration approach is proposed, by using a reference square waveform signal. A mathematical model for Total Harmonic Distortion calibration is presented and an algorithm is implemented for control the calibration process, collection and processing of results. The experimental results obtained from the performed Total Harmonic Distortion calibrations, confirm the applicability of the proposed approach.

Author Keywords: Total Harmonics Distortion of Voltage and Current

articleTitle: Comparative Assessment of Hybrid PV-Hydrogen Plant: A Case Study for Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This article presents a comparative assessment of the economic performance of different types of PV-hydrogen systems, based on an example of 100 MWp plant in Bulgaria. A hybrid grid-connected system is proposed in order to improve the overall system efficiency and to ensure two revenue streams from both - electricity and hydrogen.

articleTitle: Vernier Machines with Azimuthally Magnetized Permanent Magnets
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper complements a study initially made by the authors [1] on double stator vernier machines by introducing a dynamic simulation and presents the results of simulation of vernier machines, having flux concentration magnetization pattern of permanent magnets in Matlab/Simulink. Two machines are compared in generator mode, namely with one and two stators, carrying winding. The developed model allows to study various modes of operation and can be used in a design stage for estimation output parameters of the machines. The vernier machines are notorious for their high inductances, so reactive power compensation by series capacitors is considered for more efficient power take-off. The simulation results show that the double winding machine has higher output power as well as higher power factor. The article presents the results of modeling the operation of generators in the form of simulation oscillograms of EMF, current and power under different load conditions.

articleTitle: Quasi-Resonant Circuitry to Improve Heat Transfer and Efficiency in Induction Cooker
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper proposes a dual-mode coil structure for induction cookers using a single switching element quasi-resonant circuit and examines its effect on heating performance. In an induction cooker, the material base to be used for the heating process and the coil adaptation significantly affect the heating performance. Since the materials used are user-defined and vary, they may not always be suitable for traditional single-coil structures. The proposed dual coil structure works according to the base diameters of the material to be used and provides adaptation for different diameters. This adaptation optimizes the heat distribution on the coil, allowing the energy to be transferred more effectively. Effective energy transfer by minimizing losses improves the heating performance, making it faster and more efficient. At the same time, with this structure, the magnetic field created by the coil is applied to the material more effectively, reducing the voltage value affecting the switching element. The dual-mode coil structure with the quasi-resonant circuit was verified by simulating with MATLAB, and its improvement in heating performance in the induction cooker was experimentally observed.

articleTitle: Slim Design of LLC Resonant Converter for OLED TV by Using Toroidal Transformer
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: LLC resonant converter is used widely in the application of consumer electronics, battery charging, automotive, etc. due to its popularity and ease of control; however, its large footprint size makes it difficult to use in applications that require slim design. In this paper, a slim LLC resonant half-bridge converter is designed by adopting toroidal and EFD type transformers. The components that have a maximum of 15mm height were used in the design. The simulation and experimental designs of a 384W prototype are explained in detail and the simulation and experimental results are shared. Electromagnetic conductivity (EMC) test results are obtained for EFD type core and toroidal type core. The temperature stress test was applied at room condition. The results are as 83° for two pieces EFD type transformer, 81° for toroidal type transformer. The maximum efficiency of the prototype is calculated as 96.5%.

articleTitle: Analysis and Practical Application of the Regulatory Requirements for Coasts Power Stations in Port Complexes
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper an instrumental and analytical inspection of various characteristics and indicators of a complex “coastal station-ship” was carried out in order to establish the compatibility of operation of these facilities. the analysis makes it possible to check the extent to which the regulatory requirements of international and national standards are met.

articleTitle: Magnetoelectric Structure for Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Modern progress in science and technology is inextricably linked with the development of scientific knowledge in the field of composite materials. An important place among the known functional composite materials is occupied by magnetostrictive-piezoelectric materials, whose unique properties are due to the existence of a magnetoelectric (ME) effect in them. In such materials, the value of the ME coefficients is several orders of magnitude higher than their value in single-phase ME materials, which makes it possible to widely apply the ME effect in practice. To optimize the ME parameters, an urgent task is to study the relationship between the magnetic, electrical, and ME properties of such structures. By present time, a large number of magnetostrictive-piezoelectric composites based on ferromagnetic metals, ferrites and various types of piezoceramics have been studied theoretically and experimentally. The need for such research comes from the needs of modern mobile communication technology, Internet communications, television and radio broadcasting, radio navigation equipment and other electronic equipment in new devices based on new functional materials. A significant number of works are devoted to the research of new ME materials, including multiferroic materials [1] Multiferroic materials - materials in which two or more types of “ferro” ordering coexist simultaneously: ferromagnetic, ferroelectric and ferroelastic have broad prospects for application in energy collection systems [2- 7].

articleTitle: Modeling of Photovoltaic Power Plant Electricity Generation Using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a research on the modeling of the power and energy generation of photovoltaic power plant using various machine learning (ML) methods. Solar insolation, ambient temperature, module temperature and wind speed are used as input variables, after which the sensitivity of using each of these parameters is estimated. A set of gridsearch methods is proposed, implemented and tested. The first one researches which degree of polynomial features (in a given degree range) influence the dependent variable at most. The second gridsearch finds the optimal ML method for the data and task given. Season weather temperature data drift is noticed, and a solution is proposed and tested. The research results confirm that the use of solar radiation and ambient temperature as input variables is sufficient to obtain an accurate prediction and adding more parameters is practically not needed.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Impact of Hydroxy Gas for CO2 Emission Reduction in Diesel Car Engine
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This report examines the problem of the possibilities for reducing harmful emissions generated by diesel engines by adding hydroxy (oxy-hydrogen) gas to the fuel mixture. The presented study was carried out on a car with a diesel engine running at perfect idle mode. Emission levels of carbon oxide, nitrogen monoxide, nitrogen dioxide, total carbon and volatile organic compounds were monitored using a gas analyzer. The temperature of the exhaust gases as well as the levels of the exhaust oxygen were also monitored.

articleTitle: Methodology for determining the socio-economic factors in the performance of Cost-Benefit Analysis for the production of electricity from biomass
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The current paper proposes a Methodology for determining the socio-economic factors as a part of Cost-Benefit Analysis in the specific case of preparation project for the production of electricity from biomass. This developed methodology allows improving the quality of the decision-making process for investment project for the construction of new capacity of electricity production from biomass. The methodology presents the decision-making process based on the usage of statistic data and correction coefficients. The methodology proposes also the use of both national statistics and specially collected data in relation to the specific region in which the new energy capacity will operate.

articleTitle: Review and Conceptual Design of FPGA-based Application for Data-Driven Power Electronic Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: AI-based data-driven methods are an emerging research direction in the field of power electronics. However, because of the absence of large datasets, the development of these solutions have some barriers to overcome. To properly train machine learning algorithms and neural networks a large amount of training data is necessary. This dataset can be a union of simulation and measured data. Generating simulation data with computer simulations can be slow process and gathering real data is not cost-effective. Real-Time simulators based on FPGAs can be powerful tools to accelerate simulation, and create datasets for AI applications in a cost-effective and accurate way. In this paper the possible FPGA-based solutions, which can be applicable for the problems, have been reviewed. Their applicability have been discussed, moreover a simplified FPGA-based concept have been designed and embedded into two possible AI-based application area.

articleTitle: Control Algorithm For Bidirectional Converters In The PV Power Supply System With Intelligent PV Modules
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Application of photovoltaic (PV) modules with integrated DC-DC converters (smart PV modules) in small-scale grid connected power supply systems makes it possible to increase the amount of energy generated by the PV modules. It is possible due to simultaneous operation of all the PV modules in the maximum power point (MPP). However, simultaneous operation of the all the modules in the MPP can cause surge voltages on the elements of the integrated DC-DC converters in the case of nonuniform insolation of a series-connected smart PV modules.This paper provides a solution for the efficiency enhancement of series-connected smart PV modules. Paper also considered control algorithm for the voltage regulation of the module integrated DC-DC converters under non-uniform insolation of the PV modules. MATLAB models of the control system and simulation results presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Study and Analysis of Efficiency of Recuperative Energy Utilization in Ground Urban Electric Transport
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This report presents a comparative analysis of the measured energy regained through recuperation and a simulated model of a specific section of the tram route system in Sofia. The relations between the tram car traffic scheduling and the recuperated energy used have been accounted for.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis in Parameter Identification of a DC Motor With Independent Excitation
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of parametric identification of a DC motor with independent excitation. The identification is performed by first and second order approximations, as well as by applying wavelet functions. The values of the DC motor parameters are obtained, and the quality of the obtained mathematical models is evaluated.

articleTitle: Determining the Efficiency of an Electric Oven in the Grill Heating Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In recent years, the household electric built-in oven is the most common appliance in households. The operation of a household oven in the grill heating mode, which has the highest electricity consumption, is considered. A three-dimensional mathematical model for this mode has been developed, on the basis of which the energy parameters of the oven have been calculated.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of NdFeB Permanent Magnet’s Type and Volume on the Characteristics of a PM Claw-pole Alternator
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper proposes an analytical method to calculate the magnetic flux in the air gap of a claw-pole alternator, created by a NdFeB permanent magnet in the rotor. The proposed method can also be used to calculate the dimensions and the volume of a permanent magnet that will create a desired voltage in the machine. The possibility to obtain a certain value of the machine voltage with lower volume of rare earth material will lead to a decrease in the cost of the final product. The need for such a method is grounded on the complex geometry of this type of electrical machines, which would require a time consuming 3D modelling with FEM analysis software. Knowing the air-gap magnetic flux of the machine permits the right choice of permanent magnet type and volume, which facilitates the designing phase of the alternator. The influence of the permanent magnet's cross section and length on the magnetic flux in the air-gap of the alternator is analyzed. A comparison between the electromotive forces created by a permanent magnets with different grades is made and presented.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Possibilities for Application of a Basis-Power Model in Analysing the Energy Efficiency of Type I Fluid Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents new research on the application of the developed model for calculating the totally useful power in the systems for continuous transport of fluids and bulk cargoes. A characteristic water pumping system operated by a water supply and sewerage company in Bulgaria has been selected as the subject of the model demonstration research. A new measurement data are represented and used for the calculations. In the investigation carried out, the basis power of the pumping systems was altogether 42.71 kW and the total losses were about 42.02 kW, which is 49.9% of used energy. Other energy efficiency indices have also been used for analysis.

articleTitle: Methodical Aspects of the Analysis of Non-Harmonic Periodic Signals in Linear Two-Port Circuits
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In the paper, a methodical learning approach is proposed concerning the application of the two-port network theory and the Fourier analysis and synthesis, presented to the students as a case study. The goal is to give a general idea, on time, about the spectral analysis of a signal, circuit transfer function estimation, spectral processing, and spectral synthesis, since the classic training of Theory of Electrical Engineering is not enough oriented to the signal theory and the circuit analysis. The statement is supported with particular example case study including theory description, numeric calculations and Matlab<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> simulations. The case study could be presented to the students in form of individual or group curriculum assignment, or could be worked out by the senior lecturer as a part of a lecture.

articleTitle: The Cooling System Of High-voltage Power Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper provides the investigation of the liquid cooling system of power-electronic high-voltage assembly. There is one of the most important tasks in electrical engineering to provide the efficient cooling of different devices. In this way, the cooling of power electronic devices is very important too. The cooling system in question was designed to dissipate about 10 kW of thermal energy. Meanwhile, the electrical power rectifier in question in this paper emits near the 9 kW of thermal energy. The thermal dissipation in the cooling system much depends on the type of cool agent. The mercury was taken as a cool agent.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modelling of the Impact of Operational Factors on the Energy Efficiency of an Induction Hob
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: An analysis was made of the energy efficiency of some of the most commonly used in recent years cooking appliances: induction hobs. The obtained results and the conclusions made show that the use of modern induction hobs leads to a reduction in the energy consumed. The development of adequate models for assessing the impact of exploitation parameters on the energy efficiency of induction hobs will allow at their ecodesign to realization maximum limits for energy consumption of electric hobs.

articleTitle: Distributed Siting of Wind Farms to Minimize Fluctuations in Generated Power
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: With increasing wind penetration, the stability of the power system decreases due to fluctuations in the generated power of wind farms. Distributed siting of wind farms reduces fluctuations in power generation. A method of distributed siting of wind farms based on a genetic algorithm is proposed. The optimization problem uses the target function - the coefficient of variation of the generated power, as well as two constraints - the capacity utilization factor and the duration of operation period with generated power at least a certain level. To assess the effect of distributed siting, a day-ahead forecast of wind farm power generation is performed using a long short-term memory model.

articleTitle: Methodology for Forecasting of Energy Consumption in Trolleybus Transport with Probabilistics Indicators
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The present paper introduces further points of modification and precision to the earlier research into the analysis of trolleybus electricity consumption, by including additional probabilistic factors for traffic assessment and vehicle air conditioning.

articleTitle: Adapted Algorithm and Web-Developed Software Tool for Basis Power Analysis Using Gravity-Based Model
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a developed web-based software tool for determining the basis (totally useful) power in the systems for continuous transport of fluids and bulk cargoes, allowing fast and easy computation for more functional analysis of the energy efficiency of these systems. The developed algorithm can be used in other applications and software, or as a reference for improving the software tools. The web tool consists of five basis-power calculators for each specific type of system. The software working capacity and the applicability are tested with data from two types of systems for continuous transport of fluids - Type I and Type II. The considered transport systems are a water supply system and a pumping system for transporting condensate water from a deaerator to the drum of a steam generator in a steam power plant.

articleTitle: Study of linear generators with and without rotating permanent magnets in their stator windings
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper examines linear generators with and without rotating magnets in their stator windings. A three-dimensional model in dynamic mode has been synthesized with the help of ANSYS R19.1. The influence of the dimensions of the permanent magnets in the double sided translators on the electrical parameters of the generators has also been analyzed. Experimental studies of the generators have been performed to prove the accuracy of the simulation model.

articleTitle: Dependence of the load capacity of installation cables on the laying conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Study of the load characteristics of installation cables, determined by the maximum permissible currents and laying conditions for the purpose of their optimal and safe use.
