articleTitle: Simulation Environment for Research of Algorithms for Traffic Prioritisation in ZigBee Network
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) technologies becoming more widespread in modern life along with high-speed communication networks (4G, 5G). Sensor networks are part of the IoT, and ZigBee is one of the protocols that expected to be increasingly used in them. This paper presents a simulation environment that allows study the influence of the implemented algorithms for prioritising traffic on parameters related to Quality of Service (QoS) in ZigBee network.

articleTitle: Study of the Power Modes of Skoda Solaris 26Tr and 27Tr Trolleybuses
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this report the possible modes of operation of the electrical vehicles are examined and their energy efficiency is evaluated. The study is based on experimental and analytical investigations of the main parameters of trolleybuses with the capacity of returning energy to the grid by means of electrodynamic braking. Graphical results are presented, based on which conclusions are drawn about the modes of recuperation of the trolleybuses.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Components of the Magnetic Field Intensity According to the Rotary Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Rotary theory is a new electromagnetic theory, which appeared in 1998. It tries to explain the basic electromagnetic phenomena from another point of view and to answer to series of important questions connected with the fundamental electromagnetic laws. In rotary theory the method of moments is used in order to expand the vector of the magnetic field intensity and the vector of the magnetic flux density. These vectors are presented as moments of the vector of the current density of the tangential displacement current claiming in this way that the magnetic field is a form of a rotating electric field. All that gives the opportunity to present the Maxwell's set of electromagnetic equations in fully electrical form, which can be expressed in relativistic form, too. In this way rotary theory became a part of the special theory of relativity of Einstein. The present paper is devoted to the extraction of the formulas of the effective radius-vector and the current density of the tangential displacement current for some inductors with different shapes. The paper is dedicated also to the solution of the direct and the inverse tasks for determination of the components of the vector of the magnetic field intensity, the effective radius-vector and the current density of the tangential displacement current at arbitrary point around a given inductor.

Author Keywords: vector of the magnetic field intensity
vector of the current density of the tangential displacement current

articleTitle: Research, Analysis and Rationalization of The Operating Regimes of the Power Supply System of Resort Complex "Sunny Beach"
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: A study was conducted to establish the active power losses of and partial losses of power in a large resort complex. An inspection of the electricity distribution system in the complex and the ways of measuring, reporting and analysis of electricity consumption has been made. Various electrical indicators have been calculated, giving an idea of the state of electricity efficiency in the resort complex and opportunities have been presented for streamlining the modes of operation of its power supply system. The conducted researches show that there is a direct relationship between the electricity efficiency of the site and the dispersion component of the active losses of electricity, due to the highly uneven load schedule of the resort complex.

articleTitle: A Comparison Study of Decisions for Computer Network Laboratory in Distant Learning Education
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Compulsory social isolation during a pandemic posed new challenges for the system of education. The indispensability quickly move to a remote form of education necessitated the use of a different educational approach. During a full lockdown, three approaches for training in classes related to computer networks were used and studied - simulation products, real computer network with remote access and virtual computer network with remote access. This paper presents a comparative analysis of the investigated solutions for distance learning.

articleTitle: Mathematical analysis of power converters used in VRM modules
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The Voltage regulator module (VRM) is the backbone of every motherboard. When designing such a module many integrated circuits are available integrating the control system and possibly the whole power circuit, along with its magnetics. When such a converter needs to be analyzed the famous small-ripple approximation of the output voltage (usually assumed to be pure resistive) is used. This paper analyses the converter without using either the small ripple voltage and also using the real equivalent circuit of the powered processor. Based on the analysis results for the ripple currents and voltages are obtained. Based on the results more accurate equations are obtained for the maximum stress of all components, as well as RMS values for the current used in loss calculations.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic Modelling of the Oil Tank as a Subsystem in Hydraulic Power Drives
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The oil tank is a major component of every hydraulic drive and control systems. It also plays an important role for high-voltage transformers in electrical power distribution grids. This paper submits a thermodynamic approach for modeling the processes in the oil tank by accounting for the dynamic response of the measuring equipment - a precise digital thermometer. The dynamic block diagram is composed and the corresponding transfer functions are derived. An experiment is conducted and the results are compared with the results from a numerical simulation of the proposed model. The comparison showed good convergence between experiment and simulation.

articleTitle: Transient Processes with Starting of a Multi-Pole Asynchronous Motor with a Fan on the Shaft
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Multi-pole asynchronous motors are widely used for the electric drive of fans in air coolers. A feature of such electric drives is a large inertia of rotating masses. Therefore, the starting mode takes a long time and is accompanied by an overload of the power supply. A model has been developed in Matlab+Simulink to study transient processes. It was found as a result of the simulation that during the motor start-up the reactive component of the total power is 2.5-3 times higher than the active component. Therefore, controlled reactive power compensation is an effective factor in reducing of the load on the power supply, when a multi-pole motor is starting. An algorithm for controlling of a reactive power source is proposed. It provides the consumed current, reduced in 2.2 times in the transient mode.

articleTitle: Carrying Out of Strenght Tests of Geared Motor Box as Part of a Frequency-Controlled Traction Electric Drive
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In according to the widespread use of an asynchronous electric drive in transport, research is currently being carried out aimed at improving the dynamic and static performance of the drive. In addition, more and more attention is paid to reducing the level of vibration and acoustic noise, due to the fact that the traction electric drive units to the end customer, such as a traction converter, a geared motor unit, a top-level control unit, are supplied from different manufacturers, which requires a separate preliminary check and testing of operating modes. No less relevant is the issue of increasing the level of vibration when the GMB is powered from a voltage inverter with PWM. The purpose of this work is to perform experimental studies of the vibroactivity of the GMB, powered by a two-level voltage inverter at the stage of acceptance tests.

articleTitle: Induction Brazing Process Control
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article presents the results of a 3D simulation of an induction heating process focused on temperature control. Three of the most common materials in pipe brazing are presented. The process is studied in detail in terms of power - electrical and thermal. A method for power control in the different stages of brazing is proposed, in order to achieve optimal technological parameters. The obtained results are interesting in view of the optimal synthesis of control of the electronic technological system. The results are analyzed and guidelines for future work are proposed.

articleTitle: Essential Frequencies in the Characteristics of Control Systems, Analytical Definitions, Correspondences and Symmetries
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this article types of essential frequencies in the characteristics of integer order control systems and fractional control systems are systematized. The typical correspondences, ratios and existed symmetries between them are analytically defined and presented. The results find their applications in the theory of frequency domain design and analyses.

articleTitle: Small BEV Propulsion – Problems and Solutions
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents our search for proper design solutions by developing the interior permanent magnet synchronous motors (IPMSM) for the small battery electric vehicles (BEV) propulsion. The results of a comparative investigation of different structural configurations and various permanent magnet (PM) array are analyzed in correspondence with the specific requirements by the small-size electric cars. The basic conditions and performance evaluation by design of the motor at minimum cost are discussed.

articleTitle: A Concept for Flexible and Self-Adaptable Classification of ETIP SNET Technologies and Functionalities
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a concept for flexible and self-adaptable classification of ETIP SNET technologies and functionalities that form the basis to analyze the research and innovation (R& I) progress towards the achievement of decarbonised smart grid network by 2050. Based on analysis of the currently adopted “static” classification of ETIP SNET technologies, functionalities, and methodology for evaluating project results, the main fast evolving research and innovation drivers and needs are identified. A linking chain between functionalities and serving technologies is identified and a solid measurable process of quantification of the progress of functionalities is determined. As a result a methodology for transition of this process to flexible and adaptable for the ETIP SNET's 10-year plan is proposed.

Author Keywords: ETIP SNET Technologies and Functionalities classification

articleTitle: Comparison of Radial Forces between Double-Rotor Planetary and Coaxial Magnetic Gears
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a comparison study between coaxial and double-rotor planetary magnetic gears with regard to unbalanced radial magnetic forces. Several designs with the same overall dimensions and magnetic materials but having different combinations of pole-pairs numbers are analyzed by numerical simulation. It was shown that, unlike coaxial topology, unbalanced magnetic forces in the double-rotor planetary scheme are highly dependent on load. The magnitude of the radial forces in double-rotor planetary topology is much higher than in coaxial gear even if manufacturing intolerance of coaxial magnetic gear is taken into account. It was found that unbalanced radial forces in double-rotor planetary topology can be greatly reduced by proper selection of pole-pairs combination. Despite relatively high values of unbalanced radial forces, it is concluded that they can still be withstood by the widely available roller bearings.

articleTitle: Integrated Biologically Effective Lighting and Heating Installation for Sport Facilities
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The physical activities of humans lead to a lot of positive effects on the metabolism and boost the immune system. This positive influence can be even increased by means of lighting and irradiation systems, using the properties and effects of UV B, visual and IR radiation simultaneously. The emissions from the optical part of the spectrum of the electromagnetic waves, especially the UVB, however should be dosed carefully, because they can be harmful and can lead to skin and eye damage. The current paper presents a human centric lighting system, radiant heating system and erythema irradiation system, implemented in a single project of a sport field, aiming immune system and sport potential boosting.

Author Keywords: human centric lighting for sport fields

articleTitle: Experimental Determination of The Factors Affecting The Technological Process of Separation With Permanent Magnets
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: A separator with permanent magnets has been studied. The design of the separator and the location of the permanent magnets are described. Data are obtained experimentally on the magnetic induction along the longitudinal and transverse axes of the magnetic separator. Attention is paid to the factors affecting the separation process. The experimental results are processed by statistical modelling.

articleTitle: Air Object Detection Using Pulsar FSR
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: One possible algorithm of signal processing for airplane detection and parameters estimation using pulsar Forward Scattering Radar (FSR) is proposed. The algorithm for air target detection proposed in the article is intended for pulsar signal processing in a pulsar FSR system. The signal source is a pulsar, the receiver is a radio telescope, and the flying object is an airplane. The pulsar signal processing algorithm consists of a direct pulsar signal compensator and a detector of forward scattering signal obtained from aircraft. The proposed algorithm was simulated in the Matlab environment using a real pulsar signal.

articleTitle: Developing and Integration of New Modules for Web-based Education Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper represents a modules/addons for web-based educational platform, which delivers resources and electromagnetic compatibility related topics. The platform is accessible for variety of audience because of its web-based nature. Purpose of the additional module is to expand platform functionalities. The module aim delivers comprehensible resources to stakeholders according to electrical science standards. The system is based on top of the free open-source software which makes its development efficient with less efforts. The article describes theoretical underpinnings, features, architecture, implementation of particular module for this kind of platform, and the end application results.

articleTitle: Impedance determination of 400kV Overhead Lines of Kosovo Power System
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper focuses on determination of the power line parameters based on both calculation and measurement approaches. A separate analysis dedicated on the possible identification of the parameters causing incorrect distance relay protections operations, which may lead to power lines tripping and voltage and/or frequency instability is performed. To demonstrate the approach a case study with existing real life 400kV power line is performed [1]. For the test case identified the power line parameters are determined independently in three different ways using readily-available Matlab software tool, using direct measurement with professional instrument, and also using reference tabular values used by the transmission system operator. Based on the analytical comparison performed valuable conclusions and recommendations are provided.

articleTitle: Modeling of DC Motor Fed from Photovoltaic Panel
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The operation of a permanent-magnet DC motor, fed by photovoltaic panel is considered. Expressions have been obtained to determine operating and energy characteristics during start-up and steady-state modes. Several results are presented to illustrate the performance of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Influence of Current Harmonics Generated by Crane Systems on Some Parameters of the Power Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The report presents a study of the operation of several crane systems of a large port complex. The load schedules and the current and voltage harmonics were recorded. Based on the study the power and voltage losses in the supply lines are calculated. A direct relationship has been established between the power factor, the current harmonic and the power and voltage losses.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Regulator Functions of Power Transformers on Power Losses in Electrical Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents a study in a large industrial site to establish the possibilities for minimizing the losses of active power in the power supply system. By automatically changing the voltage of the power transformers, the generated reactive power of the synchronous motors is regulated, and with their help the optimal compensation of the reactive loads is realized. The dependence of the active power losses on the voltage and the static characteristics of the load, which is used as a criterion for efficiency, has been established.

articleTitle: Interruptions of the Power Supply in Low Voltage Cable Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The results, from a study of power supply interruptions in low voltage (LV) cable networks, are presented in the paper. Statistical processing of the data for interruptions of the power supply has been made and the type of distribution of the time of interruption, the average time of interruption, and the indicators for continuity are determined.

articleTitle: Using of HTS Materials in Construction of Linear Electric Vernier Machines
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The results of modeling linear electric Vernier generators with flat translators for wave power plants are presented. In paper we consider the design with elements made of high-temperature superconducting material (HTS), which are installed in magnetic core to reduce the leakage of magnetic flux. This type of generator is mounted in float power plants with a direct drive from a reciprocating float that transmits high forces at low speeds. For the calculations, we used a technique for modeling the properties of HTS, based on the representation of the induced currents in a superconductor in the form of magnetic moments of these currents, which made it possible to simplify the analysis of the electromagnetic field in the generator without significant additional errors.

articleTitle: Modeling of Short-Term Electric Motor Load Power Supply Disturbances in the Matlab (Simulink) Systema
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: One of the fundamental objectives to be solved in designing emergency control devices like high-speed bus transfer (HSBT) is to shape its structure and operation algorithm. These can only be synthesized based on studying and analyzing steady-state regimes and transients under the conditions of typical emergency modes (symmetric and asymmetric short-circuit faults, power supply source tripping by relay protection, and a phase open-circuit fault). Numerical experiments carried out on mathematical models of an industrial power supply system involving connected synchronous and induction motors implemented using the Matlab Simulink software system made it possible to determine the key functional modules of the HSBT fault detector. The performance adequacy of the synthesized fault detector was verified using a software emulator of the real control device, for which the parameters of electric power supply system emergency modes were used as input data.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Technical Condition of Electric Contact Joints Using Thermography
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents a study of the possibilities for the assessment of the technical condition of electric contact joints and the prognosis of their remaining useful life via the results from thermographic inspections.. The paper proposes a parametric model to estimate the defect coefficient based on the electric parameters of the contact joint or the thermal stresses of electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Design of Capacitive Coupled Transformer for Power Converter Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper, power transfer will be made with a capacitive coupled transformer structure. Inductive transformers are difficult to produce and take time because a certain number of turns are required. Instead of an inductive transformer model, a capacitive transformer model will design and test. This device will transfer power with an electric field. Four conductive layers are being in the same dielectric material in a nested structure, the power transfer will be transferred from the primary to the secondary. It is expected that the capacitive transformer model here will be better than the inductive transformer in terms of manufacturing convenience. This design will provide a function of a step-down transformer and also provide isolation between primary and secondary sides. The simulation study was performed with MATLAB Simulink, and power transfer was performed as desired. Similarly, the experimental circuits were set up and the results were taken from the oscilloscope.

articleTitle: Efficiency analysis by numerical calculation of moments and losses in a interior permanent magnets synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents a dynamic model of a synchronous motor with permanent magnets located inside the rotor (SMIPM) and with a concentrated type of stator winding. In order to improve drive efficiency, the accuracy of the model was increased by including losses and nonlinear parameters of the magnetic circuit in the motor model. The main advantage of SMIPM, compared to asynchronous and commutator motors, is achieved by providing a higher magnetic flux density in the air gap with less losses, which is reflected in higher mechanical energy delivered per unit volume of the motor, or increased motor efficiency. The paper performs numerical calculations of moments and losses in the motor by the finite element method for wide current. Accurate calculation of losses in the iron core is a very complex procedure, which is why many authors usually give the mean value of magnetic induction for the entire volume of the core. The great advantage of this calculation is that it gives a real 3D image of the machine losses for all operating conditions, at different frequencies and currents in the d and q axes. Finally, an example of measured and numerically calculated torque is given to confirm the correctness of the efficiency determination method.

articleTitle: A Wireless Power Transfer Method for Electric Vehicles by Synchronization to Secondary Resonance
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this study, an alternative method and framework for a wireless power transfer system to a moving object such as an electric vehicle or a robot are presented. The well-known systems and their common series-connected/switched road embedded segment structures are discussed and challenged. Then, an alternative method of synchronization to the secondary resonance is presented. The suggested method eliminates switches between road-embedded coil units and makes the energy transition easy among units. This method shortens the length of the EMF radiative part of road embedded segments and the application is suitable for two-dimensional floor embedded structures for robot applications. The experimental setup and the simulation results are shared with the framework of further study.

articleTitle: Water Storage Electric Power Plant with Controllable Suction Head
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Pump Storage Hydro Power Plants are a universal and competitive source of electric energy and of ancillary services for Electric Power Markets. However, inherent problems are encountered during their operation. The process of acceleration of a motor-pump unit from standstill to rated speed provokes shock loading both for the unit's parts and for the electric power system. After switching on the motor-pump unit is loaded at fool load, which is practically not controllable during the operation, i.e. the motor is responsive neither to the changes in frequency nor to the occurrence of congestions and contingencies. In order to avoid these deficiencies, special devices are required. This paper describes a new approach for mitigation of the start-up process and increasing efficiency, reliability and responsibility of ternary pump storage units. The essence of the suggestion is a complementary, third sleeve added to known hydraulic scheme of a pump storage power plant. This third sleeve is a conduit comprising a spherical valve and one or a set of ejectors installed into the suction tube between the pump impeller and the shut-off valve/gate of the suction conduit. The description includes the main functions and embodiments of suggested new constructive parts disclosed, as well as the main advantages and disadvantages of the advancements. The analysis of these advantages and disadvantages is a future scientific challenge that will enable assessment of the economic potential of the proposed novel plant.

Author Keywords: turning on and regulation of pump-motor
balancing energy and ancillary services provision

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Impact of the Squirrel-Cage Rotor Faults on the Electromagnetic Torque
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The presented paper analyzes a method for monitoring and diagnostic of the square cage rotor in induction machines via Load Torque Signature Analysis. For that purpose, an experiment was carried out, where seven identical rotors were intentionally damaged to simulate seven different defects. The spectral and time characteristics of the torque were studied, and the torque ripple was obtained.

articleTitle: Carrying Out of Tests for the Functionality of the Traction Autonomous Drives in the Conditions of Industry and Serial Production
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: A methodology has been developed that introduces a generalized approach to the synthesis of physical-simulated energy equipment through the creation of closed automatic control systems that link and synchronize the physical and virtual part of the research object. Within the framework of the methodology, a substantiation of the load generation type in virtual-physical tests is provided, an improved method for creating virtual-physical objects for energy equipment tests with several power units is proposed and practically implemented. Virtual vehicle models with combined energy equipment (CEE) have been created, which include vehicle, wheels, power drive, electric motors. The models reflect the CEE properties characteristic of the mechanical and electrical environment. The adequacy of the models is confirmed by comparison with experimental data.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Energy Losses of Supercapacitor Banks due to Self-Discharge
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In the present study is investigated the self-discharge current of a 500 F supercapacitor bank with 16.2 V rated voltage. Initially, the bank was charged from 0 to 16.2 V and the data was used to obtain its actual capacitance - 542 F. Thereafter, it was let to self-discharge in open circuit mode for a period of 62 days under room temperature conditions. A monitoring system was used in order to measure the voltage of each cell and of the bank as a whole. The analysis of the results showed that the self-discharge has an exponential character, however the exponent is also exponentially nonlinear. The obtained models allowed to obtain the leakage resistance of the capacitor, which varies from 25 Ω at 16.1 V to more than 214 kΩ at 12.5 V. This shows that when the capacitor is charged near its rated voltage, its initial power losses could go above 10 W.

articleTitle: Assessment and Analysis of the Reliability of Insulation System for High-Voltage Induction Motors Based on the Partial Discharge Level
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The object of the paper is an experimental study and analysis of the reliability of the stator winding insulation of high voltage induction motors that have been in continuous operation for more than 30 years. The analysis is based on experimental results of measurements of the dissipation factor values and partial discharges, performed on a number of induction motors in several consecutive years. They give an information to asses the current condition of the stator insulation, the trend of insulations deterioration and allow forecasting its residual life.

articleTitle: Express Method for Thermodynamic Diagnostics of Hydraulic Systems with Hydraulic Volume Rotary Machines in Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Theoretical and experimental results on the development of authors' express method for thermodynamic diagnosing of volumetric hydraulic systems under real operating conditions are presented and discussed in this report. The emphasis is on delivering integrated diagnostic indicator - overall efficiency for working cycle in real time. A mathematical model for the implementation of the method is developed and model and field experiments are held, and the feasibility of the method is demonstrated. A good match is obtained between theoretical and experimental results.

articleTitle: Determination of the Periodicity for Thermographic Tests of the Electrical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents a study of the optimal periodicity of testing when aiming to maintain certain reliability. Several methods for the assessment of reliability indicators with a small number of observations are discussed. A methodology for the determination of the period for thermographic inspections, of electrical equipment is given, in the paper.

articleTitle: Application of Active Methods in Learning the Topic of Diode Limiters Circuits
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Electronics is everywhere around us, but there is a difference between using it and understanding how it works. Such basic knowledge students receive at the beginning of their education. Here they are not so motivated and every new discipline seems to be very difficult. To overcome this, lecturers use different active methods in the learning process. The paper presents how active methods are applied in the topic of Diode Limiter Circuits and examples of students' solutions.

articleTitle: Study of the Electricity Efficiency in the Implementation of an Energy Management System in an Industrial Site of the Electrical Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Studies of the energy efficiency in a large industrial site and the impact of the implemented system for dispatch management and energy management on energy efficiency have been conducted. Different characteristic electricity indicators have been calculated. The current and voltage curves, the harmonic composition of the current and the voltage at different points of the electricity distribution network of the site are recorded for a long period of time. The losses from inactive power substances are calculated in relation to the total power losses.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Energy Balance and Electric Consumption of Luxury Yacht for Charters
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper focuses exclusively on the analysis of the energy electric load balance and electricity consumption of a vessel belonging to the class of luxury charter yachts. Thoroughly examined throughout the paper are the primary characteristic consumers typical of the object under consideration and their respective proportion in the total energy mix.

Author Keywords: reduction in greenhouse gas emissions in luxury yachts

articleTitle: A Comparison of Drain-Source Voltage Characteristics for Active and Conventional Gate Control Circuits
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This article describes the research of an active driver circuit to control a low-voltage DC-DC converter with reduced electromagnetic radiation during the transient process. The studied driver circuit has feedback on the derivative of the drain current. Studies of the transients of the transistor drain are made when controlling the R-L load. A comparative analysis has been made when controlling the power transistor with conventional and active driver with di/dt feedback. A spectral analysis of the drain voltage of the power transistor when operating in switch mode is made. The power losses on the drain of the transistor during switching on and off are investigated. A theoretical analysis of the change in current through the load during control with the active driver is made.

articleTitle: Axial Magnetic Gear Flux Density Harmonic Spectrum Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The harmonic spectrum of the flux density of the magnetic field is vital for the efficiency and for the torque interaction of the axial magnetic gears. In the present study is performed a numerical field modelling of an axial magnetic gear in order to estimate the harmonic spectrum of its axial flux density. Because of the different rotational speeds along the radial direction of the rotors, harmonic spectrum is characterized with wider harmonic distortion, compared to coaxial magnetic gears. For the purpose of this research, a three dimensional finite element model has been developed and applied. Estimation of magnetic flux density spectrums along radial circular levels is made.

articleTitle: Electric Power Quality Indicators in a Company Producing Power Electronics
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents a study of the quality of electrical energy in the power supply system of a power electronics production company. An analysis and comparison of the obtained results for each of the measured indicators for electricity quality with the respective normative documents is made.

articleTitle: Comparative study of the Tesla Model S and Audi e-Tron Induction Motors
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Tesla and Audi are two of the most iconic representative of the premium electric vehicles on the market. For their flagship vehicles, the Tesla Model S/X and the Audi e-Tron, the two manufacturers made the same choice to use squirrel cage induction machines. Thus, the paper presents a retro-engineering study of these two motors in order to compare the design strategies made by Tesla and Audi. This comparison is based on two main aspects. The technical design of the two induction motors are firstly compared. Then, the two motors output performances are computed. This study is based on the simulation results of the 2D finite element models of the each machine. Finally, an analysis of the different strategies deployed by the two manufacturers, between technological innovation and cost reduction, is proposed.

articleTitle: Efficiency Optimization of Electric Drives with Full Variable Switching Frequency and Optimal Modulation Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper, analysis and optimization of the efficiency of an electric drive with software control are discussed. The interaction between the electric machine and power electronics must be considered to increase the system efficiency with respect to the switching frequency or alternative modulation methods. The efficiency optimization is carried out considering various boundary conditions in the electric drive system such as voltage ripple and resonance effects in the high-voltage on-board network. The range of the electric vehicle can be extended by increasing the system efficiency. Or alternatively it is possible to save production costs per vehicle due to the lower battery capacity. At the same time, alternative modulation methods improve the continuous output power of the electric drive system. The losses in the inverter and the harmonic losses in the electric machine are calculated analytically. The analytical electric machine harmonic loss model is validated with finite element simulation for a fixed switching frequency. A system optimal switching frequency is measured and estimated for one operation point at a test bench and compared to the analytic calculated optimal switching frequency.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Modeling of Induction Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The issues of developing a ship's wireless centralized control system are considered. An induction motor universal mathematical model is presented, with the help of which all types of faults of an induction motor are simulated. Some of the obtained experimental results received by simulating the faults of the stator, rotor and bearings are shown.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Alternatives for Bulgarian Energy System Development
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of three alternatives for the Bulgarian energy system development based on the following key indicators: gross inland consumption, final energy consumption, emissions, installed electric capacity and electricity production. The analyzed prospective alternatives are denoted as long-term transition scenario (LTS), a scenario with additional policies and measures (WAM), and a scenario with strong utilization of photovoltaics (SUP).

articleTitle: New Approach for Smart Cities Transport Development Based on the Internet of Things Concept
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Improvement of smart cities functioning models use a variety of modern technologies, such as the Internet of Things (IoT) and complex systems for merging and processing large data aimed to make decisions on safety, security and better quality of life. An important point of different systems modelling is taking into account the technology pros and cons and, where possible, combining technologies to reduce the human-harmful effects and gain more benefits from all them. This article proposes method for smart cities transport development based on the IoT concept. For ground and air vehicles detection it is proposed to use the forward scattering (FS) effect principle. This effect is the basis of forward scattering radars (FSR) and can be applied to detect moving objects in the multi-sensor network of the IoT. An example of vehicles detection using a GPS-FS system is used in the article. The hypothesis of the study is that the increase in the number of the IoT sensors in the future as well as their operating frequency will allow the detection of relatively small mobile objects. Also, the proposed method for vehicle detection and classification will not pollute the radio with additional signals because it will use only the available ones. This technology also benefits the protection of the environment from radio pollution.

articleTitle: Research of LED dimming sources and lighting systems
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In-depth analysis of publications worldwide related to the possibilities for dimming LED sources and lighting systems. practical research has been conducted in LED lighting systems controlled by DALI and zigbee protocols. With the help of network analyzers and a goniophotometer, energy and lighting characteristics were obtained by dimming various Led sources. The study and study of the operational characteristics of controllable LED lighting systems is essential for improving their energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Numerical Examination of the Performance of an Electrohydraulic System With Discrete Control
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper submits a modeling approach and numerical simulation results concerning the performance of electrohydraulic power system with discrete control based on a direct acting high-speed servo valve. It is aimed at accounting more accurately for factors with influence on the system performance and efficiency. The possibility for energy recuperation in a hydraulic switching converter is also examined. The modeling approach combines traditional and nontraditional models of the working liquid, connecting pipelines, hydraulic accumulator, hydraulic cylinder and the servo valve. The model of the system is built with the object-oriented modeling language Modelica and simulated in the OpenModelica environment. The results are compared with the results from a traditional dynamic model to assess the significance of factors that are not accounted by the standard linear model. The simulation accounts for factors like nondissolved air content in the working liquid, its variable density, pipe wall deformation and nonlinear hydraulic resistance of the components. The steady state performance of the switching converter is examined.

articleTitle: Polymeric Composite Insulators for Overhead Power Lines. A Review of In-Service Damages and Diagnostic Approaches
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Polymeric composite insulators have been used worldwide from decades. Various cases of their failures attracted attention to the disadvantages of the design and to the necessity of tools and methods for diagnostics of their condition and remaining service life. The most important thing for the personal responsible for the maintenance is to have effective tools and knowledge to determine the insulators condition. The paper presents a review of the current experience on the maintenance of polymeric composite insulators and aims to highlight the existing diagnostic methods that are suitable for field inspection. Another purpose of the publication is to outline guidelines for development in the field of in-service diagnostics. The types of damages, the causes and the factors leading to their occurrence are presented. Various methods for diagnostics and assessment of their applicability are considered. The corresponding conclusions have been made.

articleTitle: PSS/E Based Subsynchronous Resonance Analysis Tool
publicationTitle: 2021 17th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: There are several techniques employed for analyzing the subsynchronous resonance (SSR) phenomena. Among the most common are frequency scanning analysis, eigenvalue analysis and time-domain simulations. This paper presents the implementation of a frequency scanning program based on the PSS/E power system software package. The tool is developed on Python and makes use of the PSS/E API.
